== Title ==
<span lang="ja">帝国の拡大</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-215o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">任意の位置に配備する。その位置の帝国側のカードルールを、隣接位置のカードルールにも“拡大”してつけ加えることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">皇帝は、帝国議会を“緊急事態の続く間”解散してしまい、絶対的な力を手にした。次のステップは、各惑星を恐怖で屈服させ、その権力を認めさせることである。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Expansion of the Empire.

'''Card text:''' Deploy at any location. You may extend that location's Imperial-side game text to adjacent locations, adding it to their game text.

'''Lore:''' The Emperor dissolved the Imperial Senate for the duration of the emergency and seized absolute power. His next step was to subjugate the planets through fear and force them to recognize his authority.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 3
* '''Printed subtype:''' Effect
* '''Uniqueness:''' Unique (one marker)<ref name="jp-face" />
